name: Rheon Systems Sentinel CorpSec Field Loadout
description:
Matte slate-grey ballistic shell jacket over a graphene-weave tac-vest, paired with articulated cargo trousers in charcoal ripstop. Helmet-ready collar, integrated spinal-rig channel running the full dorsal seam, and chrome-arm cutaway cuffs with magnetic closure. Knee reinforcement panels, mag-lock boot interface tabs at the ankle, and a detachable hood with embedded AR visor mount. Corporate insignia patches are Velcro-swappable — contractors change allegiance fast.

Boots are Harkon Siege derivative: steel-composite toe, oil-resistant sole. A low-profile trauma plate carrier sits under the jacket, invisible at a glance.
functionality: Ballistic resistance (Level IIIA equivalent), spinal-rig and chrome-arm compatibility, AR visor mount, detachable hood, mag-lock boot tabs, trauma plate carrier, climate-wicking inner lining, and swappable corponation insignia.
what_it_says: You are a paid instrument of force — professional, replaceable, and dangerous enough that most people step aside.
worn_by: off-duty military transitioning to private sector
story_hooks: The insignia patch on this kit has been swapped six times — the last employer's logo is still faintly visible beneath the current one.
A CorpSec officer wearing this shows up dead in a Tier 2 transit tunnel — the trauma plates were removed before they were killed.
A player character finds this kit in a locker with a note: 'Don't ask who wore it last.'
